title: Rick Explains Quantum Computers to Morty
caption: Quantum computing, explained by Rick! #ScienceWithRick #QuantumComputing

scenes.script: Uh, Rick? What’s the deal with quantum computers? Are they like... regular computers on steroids?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: No, Morty! Classical computers are like your dumb brain—only one thought at a time. Quantum computers? They’re like my brain: superposition!
Wait, so they can be 0 and 1 at the same time? That’s weird. Can I get a real-world example?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty with a dumb looking without understanding.png

scenes.script: Sure, Morty! Think of a coin spinning in the air. It’s both heads and tails until it lands. Qubits are like that, but way more annoying.
Okay... so how does this help? Can they, like, crack passwords or something?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: Exactly! They can factor big numbers fast, which means breaking encryption—like your mom’s Facebook password, Morty!
Great, so now they’re hacking my socials? What else?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty with a dumb looking without understanding.png

scenes.script: Oh, Morty. They can model molecules for new drugs—like finding cures that your stupid brain couldn’t imagine!
Okay, so why aren’t they everywhere? Sounds like they’re the future.
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: Because qubits are like your love life, Morty—unstable and error-prone! They need crazy cold temps to work.
So what’s the point? We can’t even use them now!
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty with a dumb looking without understanding.png

scenes.script: They’re still in development, Morty. But when they get good—bam! Quantum advantage. Like me, only better at math.
So basically, you’re saying quantum computers are like the Rick of computers—super powerful but a pain in the ass?
scenes.character_image: volume/resources/LoreLabs/images/morty/morty looking to another side without caring.png

scenes.script: Exactly, Morty! Now go study some quantum physics so you can impress a girl for once.
